question: Why do the pages with the most links keep getting even more?
answer: Pages with many links keep gaining more, because each newcomer lands on a random page. Some newcomers link to that page directly. Others first follow that page's link and then link to wherever it leads, so well-linked pages collect links faster.
move: Being found makes you easier to find.
